import os, glob
from google.cloud import bigquery

proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
c=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
staging=f"{proj}.{ds}.incremental0872b7_staging"
final=f"{proj}.{ds}.incremental0872b7"

schema=[
    bigquery.SchemaField("row_id","STRING"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("account_id","STRING"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("event_time","INT64"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("amount","FLOAT64"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("category","STRING"),
]
# fresh staging

files=sorted(glob.glob("data/increment_*.csv"))
print("loading files:", files)
write=bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_APPEND
for i,f in enumerate(files):
    job_cfg=bigquery.LoadJobConfig(
        schema=schema, skip_leading_rows=1,
        source_format=bigquery.SourceFormat.CSV,
        write_disposition=(bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_TRUNCATE if i==0 else write),
    )
    with open(f,"rb") as fh:
        job=c.load_table_from_file(fh, staging, job_config=job_cfg)
    job.result()
    print("loaded", f, "->", job.output_rows)

# build final table with derived feature_timestamp (TIMESTAMP) from epoch-ms event_time
q=f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `{final}` AS

       TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(event_time) AS feature_timestamp
FROM `{staging}`
"""

import os, glob
from google.cloud import bigquery

proj = os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']
ds = os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
c = bigquery.Client(project=proj)
staging = f"{proj}.{ds}.incremental0872b7_staging"
final = f"{proj}.{ds}.incremental0872b7"

schema = [
    bigquery.SchemaField("row_id", "STRING"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("account_id", "STRING"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("event_time", "INT64"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("amount", "FLOAT64"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("category", "STRING"),
]
c.query(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{staging}`").result()
files = sorted(glob.glob("data/increment_*.csv"))
print("loading files:", files)
for i, f in enumerate(files):
    cfg = bigquery.LoadJobConfig(
        schema=schema, skip_leading_rows=1,
        source_format=bigquery.SourceFormat.CSV,
        write_disposition=(bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_TRUNCATE if i == 0
                           else bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_APPEND),
    )
    with open(f, "rb") as fh:
        job = c.load_table_from_file(fh, staging, job_config=cfg)
    job.result()
    print("loaded", f, "rows:", job.output_rows)

q = f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `{final}` AS
SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time, amount, category,
       TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(event_time) AS feature_timestamp
FROM `{staging}`
"""
c.query(q).result()
c.query(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{staging}`").result()

t = c.get_table(final)
print("FINAL rows:", t.num_rows, "cols:", [f.name for f in t.schema])
r = list(c.query(
    f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) d, MIN(event_time) mn, MAX(event_time) mx FROM `{final}`"
).result())[0]
print("count", r.n, "distinct_row_id", r.d, "min_event_time", r.mn, "max_event_time", r.mx)

import os
import google.cloud.aiplatform as aiplatform
from vertexai.resources.preview import feature_store as fs
proj=os.environ["GCP_PROJECT"]; loc=os.environ["GCP_LOCATION"]; ds=os.environ["GCP_BQ_DATASET"]

    fg=fs.FeatureGroup.create("incremental0872b7",
        source=fs.FeatureGroupBigQuerySource(uri=uri, entity_id_columns=["row_id"]),
        description="Events feature table; key row_id, event-time event_time (epoch ms)")
    print("Created FeatureGroup:", fg.name)

existing={f.name for f in fg.list_features()}
print("existing features:", existing)
for col in ["account_id","event_time","amount","category"]:
    if col in existing:
        print("feature exists:", col); continue
    fg.create_feature(col, version_column_name=col)
    print("created feature:", col)
print("ALL FEATURES:", [f.name for f in fg.list_features()])
print("SOURCE:", fg.source)
'

import os, glob
from google.cloud import bigquery

proj=os.environ['GCP_PROJECT']; ds=os.environ['GCP_BQ_DATASET']
c=bigquery.Client(project=proj)
staging=f"{proj}.{ds}.incremental0872b7_staging"
final=f"{proj}.{ds}.incremental0872b7"

schema=[
    bigquery.SchemaField("row_id","STRING"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("account_id","STRING"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("event_time","INT64"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("amount","FLOAT64"),
    bigquery.SchemaField("category","STRING"),
]
# fresh staging
c.query(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{staging}`").result()
files=sorted(glob.glob("data/increment_*.csv"))
print("loading files:", files)
write=bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_APPEND
for i,f in enumerate(files):
    job_cfg=bigquery.LoadJobConfig(
        schema=schema, skip_leading_rows=1,
        source_format=bigquery.SourceFormat.CSV,
        write_disposition=(bigquery.WriteDisposition.WRITE_TRUNCATE if i==0 else write),
    )
    with open(f,"rb") as fh:
        job=c.load_table_from_file(fh, staging, job_config=job_cfg)
    job.result()
    print("loaded", f, "->", job.output_rows)

# build final table with derived feature_timestamp (TIMESTAMP) from epoch-ms event_time
q=f"""
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `{final}` AS
SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time, amount, category,
       TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(event_time) AS feature_timestamp
FROM `{staging}`
"""
c.query(q).result()
c.query(f"DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `{staging}`").result()

t=c.get_table(final)
print("FINAL rows:", t.num_rows, "cols:", [f.name for f in t.schema])
rows=list(c.query(f"SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) d, MIN(event_time) mn, MAX(event_time) mx FROM `{final}`").result())[0]
print("count", rows.n, "distinct row_id", rows.d, "min/max event_time", rows.mn, rows.mx)
PY
